finalText:
**Build passes now.** Exit `0`, two real bugs fixed.

`resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the bump renamed it `retryCount`. It threw on `undefined.toFixed`. Now it reads the new name, falls back to the old. See [src/core/options.js:9](src/core/options.js:9).

`isBackoffEnabled` threw on unset flags. The new loader leaves them `undefined`, not `false`. Unset now means off. See [src/net/retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8).

The 8 warnings are real noise. They come from the fake bundler, not your source.

Next: clear the `DEP0198` `Buffer()` and `crypto.createCipher` uses if you want zero warnings.
